title: Current-v6 soup uniform mixed-opponent smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Starting from the strongest current-v6 external-tested soup, a reset-optimizer all-policy-head continuation can execute an auditable 50/50 procedural and uniform diverse learned-opponent mixture with fresh accounting, finite PPO/source-KL metrics, and identity-safe assignment provenance.
material_change: Correct the pre-environment scheduler incompatibility by using a uniform four-checkpoint learned population alongside a 50% procedural share; keep soup initialization/reference and all other training controls fixed.
baseline: The immediately preceding adaptive mixture was rejected by CLI before environment initialization with zero hands. Prior all-procedural and Standard10-initialized learned-league routes do not test this combination.

notes: Technical gate only: >=8192 physical hands; fresh counters and optimizer; all four learned identities plus procedural hands observed; assignment/session evidence pass; finite metrics; zero KL early stops. Smoke reward is not a strength gate.

Training completed iter2: 8,674 physical/8,215 transition-bearing hands, 4,407 procedural. Four learned opponent identities all appeared. Source KL max0.000363, zero KL stops, optimizer fresh step56 versus stale source step984, and only the ten allowed policy/preflop/value tensors changed.

result.summary: Corrected uniform mixed-opponent smoke completed 8,674 physical hands with all four learned identities and 4,407 procedural hands; fresh optimizer/accounting, tensor scope, RNG chain, hashes, and finite health all passed.
result.conclusion: The current-v6 soup can validly initialize a mixed procedural/learned all-heads continuation. This technical result supports a matched diversity pilot but is not strength evidence.
result.next_step: Start both arms freshly from the exact soup with identical seed/deal/procedural schedule and source KL: control uses only the soup learned opponent; treatment uses the preregistered four-checkpoint current-v6 population. Select external testing only after terminal health and outcome-blind source-drift review.
